item: R4 / A4 - a field that is both time-driven and action-driven
classification: INSTRUMENT ATTESTATION, reported apart from the pre-registered corpus. Nothing here enters A, B or C, and nothing here is evidence about any game.

parameters.shiftToleranceUnchanged: the pre-registered value 3 is not altered

rule: the phase-leak indicator is a state of the instrument. UNCERTAIN means this horizon cannot be read cleanly; it never means a particular confirmation is false. A field with two causes lands there while being correctly confirmed.

git.commitSubject: S11B-R / R4: slowTime's period was five times the shortest horizon, not an order of magnitude

checks.check: timeAndAction is confirmed AND the neutral arm moves it, at the same horizon
the phase-trust status at those horizons is UNCERTAIN, not a false-event verdict
pureTime is moved by the neutral arm
pureAction is never moved by the neutral arm
pureAction is confirmed under its own mask
the neutral arm reaches slowTime later than it reaches pureTime
slowTime is never falsely confirmed under the pulse train
checks.note: reported, not asserted: a time-only field confirmed at a long horizon is the tolerance-scaling limit already recorded as C24.4, not a new defect.

checks.check: the probe reports the six quantities separately, by name
the phase-trust flag is reported at horizon level AND per address, separately
cadence positive control: cadenceOnly is confirmed under the train and not under the duration-matched hold
checks.groundTruth: a continuous hold is ONE press edge and cannot move this field at any duration; a train of 3 or more pulses can
checks.note: reported, not asserted. A null result here is a measured limit of the instrument and is published as one; forcing it to be non-zero is exactly what this programme forbids.

checks.check: cadenceOnly is NOT confirmed under any continuous hold
why timeAndAction is not the cadence control: it is confirmed under both structures
checks.note: its action half fires on every edge, so the single edge of a continuous hold already moves it. Recorded so the empty train-only set is not mistaken for a statement about cadence.
